title: No LAN No CHEAT
description: Completely removes the LAN interface to disable gamemode and command switching.
body:
## No LAN : EN
No LAN is a small client-side Fabric mod for Minecraft 26.2.
It removes access to the LAN interface from the pause menu. Its goal is simple: prevent using "Open to LAN" as an easy way to enable commands in a single-player world where cheats were disabled.
If any bugs are present , please add me on discord : pluplume09 Thanks for using
